meta.name: Shaqyru — Annual Report DNA
meta.description: Design identity distilled from five American annual report covers the owner chose (12 Nov 2026), applied to a dark venue catalog for Almaty: printed-page geometry, small marginal type, documentary photography, cut-paper collage, step-and-repeat numerals.

color.palette_type: analogous warm darks (brown-black, oxblood, gold) with one complementary cool (Kraftco navy, Rand periwinkle)

primary.role: page ground — Heublein's brown-black (37.6% of that cover)

secondary.role: oxblood red for printed plates and the brand band — Coca-Cola 1983 bottle red

accent.role: muted gold for the one selected thing: picked date, time, table, active filter (Heublein water highlights)

neutral.usage: Light end is text on the dark ground (#f3ead6 headings, #e9d7b5 body, #c9b48f labels, #a8916d hints); dark end is ground and rules. Cream #e9d7b5 doubles as the paper of light sections.

color.contrast_strategy: High contrast cream-on-brown-black for text; colour lives in full-bleed images and printed plates, never behind body text. Mid-tones (#503523, #6d4c2e) only as rules and shadows.

font_families.heading: "SF Pro Display", "Inter Tight" (owner's iitaly.net stack) — a neo-grotesque in the role of News Gothic / Helvetica on the covers
font_families.mono: none (tabular figures of the sans instead)

typography.font_style_notes: Covers pair a modern serif for numerals and mastheads (Kraftco's ball-terminal Didone '1972/1923', Coca-Cola's 'Annual Report 1983') with a small neutral grotesque for the company line. Display numerals use a Didone (Old Standard TT, which covers Cyrillic and Kazakh); everything else stays in the owner's Inter Tight. Titles are small and sit at an edge of the image like a caption; scale contrast comes from the numerals, not from huge headlines. Sentence case (owner's rule), tabular figures for times and money.

spacing.section_rhythm: Each section is a 'page': a full-bleed plate or band butts against the next with no gap (pages of a report), text sections inside get 64–96px vertical padding.

layout.grid_system: 12-column print grid with a fixed outer margin (owner's edge: 20 / 24 / max(32px, (100% − 1216px)/2))
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric — image plates full-bleed or half-bleed, type pinned to top-left / bottom-left corners

shape.border_usage: hairline 1px rules only; no outlined boxes except inputs and slot cells
shape.divider_style: 1px rules in a mid-tone (#3a2a22 on dark, #c9b48f on paper), full column width, like financial tables

elevation.depth_cues: overlapping printed plates and paper margins; never shadows or blur

iconography.style: almost none — words instead of icons; the only marks are the S logotype and typographic signs (·, «»)

motion.entrance_pattern: page fade-in only; plates do not slide
motion.philosophy: minimal functional — print does not move

components.button_style: rectangular, 0 radius, 48px; primary = cream fill with brown-black text; secondary = text with a hairline underline
components.input_style: rectangular, 0 radius, 1px #3a2a22 border on #2e221d, cream text; focus = gold border
components.card_style: no card: a venue is a printed plate (4:5 cover image in a cream paper margin with its name set small at the bottom edge) followed by caption lines on the page ground
components.navigation_pattern: masthead line: logotype left, two text links and language right; no pills
components.list_style: ruled tables: hairline between rows, figures right-aligned and tabular
components.component_notes: Filters are a ruled row of text tabs (active = gold underline). Time slots are a timetable of rectangular cells. Stats are big Didone numerals with a small caption, like a report's highlights page.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: the city's annual report: each place a printed cover, the day's numbers in a highlights spread
aesthetic.era_influence: American corporate modernism 1954–1987 (Paul Rand, Heublein, Kraftco, Coca-Cola reports)

visual_language.ornamentation: none — only the image and the type
visual_language.whitespace_usage: large dark fields and empty sky inside images; text blocks narrow
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: weight in one image per page, type light and peripheral
visual_language.texture_usage: film grain and paper grain inside images; offset misregistration in collages; UI itself flat

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast between one image or numeral and small type
composition.flow_direction: top-down pages; inside a page, image first, caption second
composition.grouping_strategy: rules and paper margins, not boxes
composition.negative_space_role: the subject of half the covers: dark water, empty sky, flat painted wall

imagery.photo_treatment: documentary 35mm, low saturation except one luminous zone, deep blacks, grain, slight softness; no glowing sun discs, no HDR, no 'golden hour everywhere'
imagery.illustration_style: Paul Rand cut-paper collage: real photographed objects cut out and pasted onto flat gouache shapes, cotton-wool smoke, white paper border; three to four flat colours
imagery.graphic_elements: step-and-repeat Didone numerals fading navy→red; hairline rules
imagery.pattern_usage: none in UI; brick or line-screen only inside images
imagery.image_shape: sharp rectangles: 4:5 covers for venues, full-bleed plates for sections

interaction_feel.feedback_style: colour and underline change; no motion

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative naming the action and the time ('Забронировать на 20:00')

background_effects.description: Grounds are flat; grain lives inside the images

text_effects.description: Kraftco 1972: a Didone numeral repeated ~28 times, each copy shifted down a few px, colour stepping from navy-blue (#2b3a8f) at the top to red (#c0392b) at the bottom with low opacity, so the figures smear into vertical columns; the last copy is solid.
text_effects.technology: SVG <text> repeated with computed fill and y

image_effects.description: Images sit in paper margins; hover dims slightly

visual_effects.composite_notes: What made the previous build read as generated, measured against these covers: (1) saturation — our hero sky #DC7E05 and category grounds #CE301F/#E39417/#D8521B are far more chromatic than any reference except Rand's single vermilion; (2) web furniture — 28px rounded tiles, pill buttons and chips, shadows, glass card over the photo — none of which exist in print; (3) huge headlines over the image, where the covers set the title small at an edge; (4) the Kraftco idea was approximated with bands and rings instead of its actual step-and-repeat numerals; (5) the collages were over-rendered single illustrations rather than Rand's photo cut-outs on flat paint.
